channel.title: RealHunt: the 50 newest homes
channel.description: The 50 newest homes on RealHunt, each checked by a person and scored from 70 to 98.

item.title: €127,100 · Cottage-style house with a new kitchen near the waterfront in Pictou, Nova Scotia
item.description: Pictou, Nova Scotia. 132 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 86. Asking C$199,900 (about €127,100) for a white cottage-style house of about 132 m² in the heart of Pictou, a historic harbour town on the Northumberland Strait. The kitchen is brand new, with white units, wood counters and an island, and opens to a bright dining room with exposed beams. There is a large bathroom with laundry on the ground floor, and three bedrooms plus an office upstairs. The fenced back garden has a big new deck, a shed and a wired workshop. Downtown shops, cafes, the marina and the waterfront are a few steps away.

item.title: €195,000 · Furnished two-bedroom flat with private yard and shared pool in Mesa Chorio, Paphos
item.description: Mesa Chorio, Paphos. 74 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 78. A two-bedroom ground-floor apartment in Mesa Chorio, a village on the edge of Paphos, sold with its own separate title deed and with the furniture included. 74 m² inside with an open-plan kitchen, dining and living area and a bathroom with shower, plus a 19 m² covered veranda, a 3 m² open veranda and the exclusive use of a private yard. The complex has a shared swimming pool and the flat has a covered parking space. The advert places it about 250 m from the village church and 2.7 km from Paphos General Hospital. Asking €195,000, about €2,640/m². Communal fees are not stated.

item.title: €180,000 · Two-bedroom duplex with private garden and shared pool in Costa de Antigua
item.description: Costa de Antigua, Fuerteventura. 61 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 79. A two-floor home of about 61 m2 in the Los Soles complex on the east coast of Fuerteventura, a few minutes from Caleta de Fuste and its beaches. Downstairs is a bright living room with an open modern kitchen and a guest toilet, upstairs two bedrooms and a full bathroom. The private rear terrace garden opens towards the communal pool, which the advert says was recently renovated and has showers and toilets. Described as in excellent condition and ready to move into. Community fees are not stated in the advert, so ask before making an offer.

item.title: €109,000 · Restored brick house with courtyard in the old centre of Amandola, Le Marche
item.description: Amandola, Le Marche. 85 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 78. An independent brick house in the historic centre of Amandola, at the foot of the Sibillini mountains, fully restored with an anti-seismic structure according to the advert. About 85 m2 over four levels: a living and dining room with kitchenette and a shower room on the entry floor, two double bedrooms and a second bathroom above, an attic used as a studio and a cellar with a cave cut into the rock. It has a small private courtyard, double glazing and radiators on town gas. The upper floor has its own street door. Energy class G.

item.title: €130,000 · Renovated detached house with open hill views in the eastern Algarve, near Alcoutim
item.description: Alcoutim e Pereiro, Alcoutim, Faro. 77 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 80. A detached single-storey house with a new tiled roof and an Algarve chimney at the edge of a small hill village, about 15 km from Alcoutim. Recently renovated and ready to move into: 77 m² with an open kitchen and living room, white units with dark worktops and built-in appliances, a bedroom plus a second room, and a shower room with glass bricks. Open views over the hills of the eastern Algarve. The advert puts Mértola and Vila Real de Santo António around 30 km away. Asking €130,000, about €1,690/m², low for a finished house in the Algarve.

item.title: €149,000 · Fully renovated 150 m² semi-detached house with garden in Neudau, Styrian spa country
item.description: Neudau, Styria. 150 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 85. A roomy half of a house in a quiet green spot in the market town of Neudau, in the east Styrian thermal spa region, with the town's services within walking distance. It was completely renovated in 2025 and 2026: new water pipes, bathrooms, windows, doors, floors and tiles, and all the electrics redone. New radiators, infrared panels and a new Swedish stove. Kitchen and dining room, two bedrooms and a WC on the ground floor, a large living room upstairs, and a cellar with a bathroom. About 170 m² of flat garden. Ready to move into. Asking €149,000, about €993/m², after a price cut.

item.title: €150,000 · Two-bedroom flat with a balcony and shared pool near Playa Dorada, Puerto Plata
item.description: Puerto Plata, Puerto Plata. 103 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 84. Asking US$165,000 (about €150,000) for a resale flat of 103 m² in Puerto Plata, on the north coast, which the advert places very close to Playa Dorada beach. It has two bedrooms, two bathrooms, a living and dining room, a kitchen with an island and a balcony. The building has a swimming pool, one assigned parking space and visitor parking. The price includes the washer-dryer, fridge, cooker and extractor hood, so it is close to ready to live in. Maintenance fee US$127, stated without a period, probably monthly.

item.title: €143,000 · Three-bedroom house in a gated community with a pool in Mazatlán, Sinaloa
item.description: Mazatlán, Sinaloa. 75 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 81. Asking MX$2,900,000 (about €143,000) for a two-storey house of about 75 m² in Coto San Julio, a gated cluster in the Hacienda del Seminario area of Mazatlán, listed as about ten years old. It has three bedrooms with wardrobes, two bathrooms, a living room, dining area, a remodelled kitchen, a patio and one parking space. Split air conditioning and ceiling fans are fitted. Residents share a swimming pool and the entrance has security around the clock. The photos show a tidy, furnished home that looks ready to move into. Mazatlán is a Pacific beach city. Maintenance fee not stated.

item.title: €169,000 · Fully renovated three-bedroom granite house in a quiet village near Tábua
item.description: Espadanal, Tábua, Coimbra. 125 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 80. A granite village house rebuilt inside from top to bottom, about 5 km from the town of Tábua. The advert lists new windows, doors and shutters, new wiring and plumbing, rock-wool insulation on the inner walls, recessed lighting and a new fitted kitchen, so there is nothing left to do. Ground floor with open kitchen, living room and WC, and a first floor with three bedrooms, a full bathroom and a spare room for laundry or office. About 142 m2 of built area, 125 m2 useful. Energy class C, which is unusual for a stone house at this price.

item.title: €119,500 · Renovated town house with a central patio in the centre of La Charité-sur-Loire, Burgundy
item.description: La Charité-sur-Loire, Burgundy. 156 m². 4 bedrooms. RealHunt score 81. A renovated town house in the centre of La Charité-sur-Loire, the old priory town on the Loire, with shops, schools and transport close by. 156 m² with six rooms, four of them bedrooms, arranged around a central patio, plus a redone 27 m² studio-type space with a new roof and a large cellar. Electrics redone, full insulation carried out in 2011, double glazing, mains gas heating, mains drainage and fibre available. Asking €119,500, about €766/m². Property tax €970 a year; the advert gives gas at about €1,200 and electricity about €1,000 a year.

item.title: €99,000 · Renovated stone house with Douro valley views in Samodães, Lamego, sold furnished
item.description: Samodães, Lamego, Viseu. 70 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 85. A traditional house in Samodães, above the Douro near Lamego, fully rebuilt and renovated in 2025 and sold furnished and equipped. 70 m² on two floors: a living room with exposed schist walls, new beams, a kitchenette and a dining table downstairs, two bedrooms and a shower room upstairs. The windows look across terraced vineyards to a bend of the river. It already holds a local lodging licence (AL), so it can be used as a home or let to visitors. Freshly whitewashed outside with new wooden shutters. Private sale. Asking €99,000, about €1,415/m².

item.title: €126,500 · Furnished two-bedroom house with Moray Firth sea views in the harbour town of Macduff
item.description: Macduff, Aberdeenshire. 70 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 83. A well-presented semi-detached house in the centre of Macduff, a coastal town on the Moray Firth in north-east Scotland, sold fully furnished and ready to move into. 70 m² with an entrance hall, an open-plan kitchen and living room with all appliances included, two bedrooms and a fully fitted bathroom upstairs. The front bedroom looks out over the Moray Firth. Modern fittings throughout, and the advert says it works equally as a permanent home. Freehold. Asking offers over £110,000 (about €126,500), around €1,800/m². Council tax band B.

item.title: €139,000 · Fully renovated four-bedroom house with balcony and garden in Bergerac, Dordogne
item.description: Bergerac, Dordogne. 150 m². 4 bedrooms. RealHunt score 86. A 150 m² stone house in Bergerac, on the Dordogne river, on a plot of about 270 m² and close to shops and services. The advert describes a total renovation with an energy rating of C and ducted reversible heating and cooling. Five rooms including four bedrooms, two bathrooms and three WCs, plus a balcony, a garden and two parking spaces. It is one of two lots in a small co-ownership with no running charges, as stated in the advert. Asking €139,000, about €927/m², which is low for a renovated house of this size in the Dordogne.

item.title: €100,000 · Beamed stone duplex with a lake-view garden and garage above Lake Iseo, Parzanica
item.description: Parzanica, Lake Iseo, Lombardy. 80 m². 1 bedrooms. RealHunt score 81. A two-storey flat of 80 m² in the stone village of Parzanica, 750 metres up and, according to the advert, a ten-minute drive from Lake Iseo. The ground floor has a living room under exposed beams, an eat-in kitchen with a fireplace and a guest toilet. A timber staircase leads to a double bedroom and a shower room below a pitched wooden ceiling. A small private garden looks straight down on the lake and Monte Isola, and a single garage is included. Built in 2000, energy class G. Asking €100,000 after a price cut of about 17%.

item.title: €95,000 · Four-bedroom village house with a guest flat and covered terrace in Secinaro, Abruzzo
item.description: Secinaro, Abruzzo. 171 m². 4 bedrooms. RealHunt score 83. A large house in the mountain village of Secinaro, made by joining three small flats, 171 m² in all. One part still works as a separate guest flat with its own living room, kitchen, bathroom and a bedroom with a balcony. The main home has vaulted ceilings, a kitchen with a dining room, a living room with a fireplace, further bedrooms and bathrooms, and balconies looking over the valley. A covered terrace at the entrance faces the village and the mountains. Furnished and lived in, with several entrances. The Sirente-Velino park starts at the edge of the village. Asking €95,000, about €555/m².

item.title: €115,000 · Four-level town house ready to live in at Collesano, in the Madonie hills near Cefalù
item.description: Collesano, Sicily. 200 m². 4 bedrooms. RealHunt score 80. A terraced house on four levels in the centre of Collesano, a town inside the Madonie Park near Cefalù. The advert describes it as bright, in excellent condition and ready to live in at once. Two big storerooms with two toilets on the ground floor, two large rooms and a bathroom on the first, a bedroom, a master bedroom and a bathroom on the second, and on top a kitchen and living room under timber ceilings with a balcony facing the mountains. The agent gives about 220 m² in the text and 200 m² in the details. Asking €115,000, under €600/m².

item.title: €85,000 · Three-bedroom seaside house with a paved courtyard in Torremezzo di Falconara, Calabria
item.description: Torremezzo, Falconara Albanese, Calabria. 101 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 84. A semi-detached house of 101 m² in Torremezzo, the seaside part of Falconara Albanese on the Tyrrhenian coast of Calabria. The advert gives its condition as excellent: four rooms on the ground floor with a separate fitted kitchen, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. Outside there is a covered veranda with room for a table and armchairs, a large paved courtyard with a garden corner, and a bedroom annex with a timber ceiling. The photos show it furnished and well kept, with tiled floors and wooden shutters. Asking €85,000, about €840/m². Energy class G.

item.title: €175,000 · Renovated stone village house with courtyards in Karydi, eastern Crete
item.description: Karydi, Agios Nikolaos, Crete. 160 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 87. A stone house of 160 m2 on two levels in the hill village of Karydi, renovated in two stages, 2010 and 2024, and sold fully furnished. The ground floor has an open kitchen with a sitting corner by the fireplace, a large living and dining room, a double bedroom and a big bathroom with laundry area opening to the yard. Upstairs is a second bedroom with two balconies. Front and back yards, a store room, solar water heating and air conditioning in the living room and both bedrooms. About 20 to 25 minutes by car from Elounda and Neapoli, and an hour from Heraklion airport.

item.title: €121,000 · Traditional two-bedroom cottage with wood burner and large garden in Whithorn, Galloway
item.description: Whithorn, Dumfries and Galloway. 67 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 81. A traditional terraced cottage in the centre of Whithorn, in the far south-west of Scotland. 67 m² with two well-proportioned bedrooms, a living room with a wood-burning stove and a recently refurbished modern kitchen. Behind the house, steps lead up to a large enclosed garden with a kept lawn, mature planting, a raised paved sitting area, a greenhouse and a generous outbuilding. Freehold, mains water and sewerage, electric heating. Asking offers over £105,000 (about €121,000), around €1,800/m². Council tax band A, the lowest band.

item.title: €160,000 · Three-bedroom townhouse with two terraces in La Marina, Costa Blanca
item.description: La Marina, Elche, Alicante. 116 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 83. A townhouse of 116 m2 in the La Marina urbanisation on the southern Costa Blanca, extended upwards to give three bedrooms and two bathrooms, including an extra-large main bedroom. It faces east for morning sun and is described as ready to move into. The photos show a tiled front terrace with awning, a first-floor balcony, a fitted kitchen with dishwasher, a long living and dining room with air conditioning and a small roof solarium. At about 1,380 euros per m2 it is well below most homes on this stretch of coast. Community fees are not stated in the advert.

item.title: €213,600 · Fully renovated brick rowhouse with a fenced yard in Lancaster, Pennsylvania
item.description: Lancaster, Pennsylvania. 127 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 86. Asking US$235,000 (about €213,600) for a brick rowhouse of about 127 m² that has been redone from top to bottom. The main floor is open plan with 9-foot ceilings and vinyl plank floors, and the new kitchen has white cabinets, butcher block counters, gas cooking and all appliances. Upstairs are three bedrooms and two new bathrooms with tiled showers, one of them en suite. Gas heating, central air, a usable basement and a fenced back garden complete it. Lancaster is a historic small city in Pennsylvania Dutch country. Yearly property tax US$1,744, no HOA fee.

item.title: €139,000 · Renovated one-bedroom country house on 4,000 m² of land near Francavilla Fontana, Puglia
item.description: Francavilla Fontana, Puglia. 85 m². 1 bedrooms. RealHunt score 80. A single-storey country house of about 85 m² on 4,000 m² of gated private land with olive trees, around 10 minutes from Francavilla Fontana. The inside has been redone in a modern style: an open living room with a fitted kitchen and breakfast bar, a double bedroom, a tiled shower room with washer and dryer, air conditioning and a wood stove. Outside there are gravel terraces, a hammock under the trees and a sun-lounger corner. The owner puts Brindisi airport 25 to 30 minutes away, with both the Adriatic and Ionian coasts in easy reach. Private sale. Asking €139,000.

item.title: €200,000 · Victorian house with original oak woodwork opposite a park in Marietta, Ohio
item.description: Marietta, Ohio. 191 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 90. Asking US$220,000 (about €200,000) for a 1929 Victorian of about 191 m² in the centre of Marietta, a historic river town in south-east Ohio. The oak staircase, pocket doors, glazed French doors and wide trim are all still in place. It has three bedrooms, two bathrooms (one on the ground floor), an eat-in kitchen, a separate dining room, ground-floor laundry and a floored walk-up attic. Outside there is a front porch, rear deck, fenced back garden and a one-car detached garage. A city park, the library and the river trail are across the street or close by. Yearly property tax US$2,127, no HOA fee.

item.title: €130,000 · Furnished two-bedroom flat with title deeds and a shared pool in Mazotos, Larnaca
item.description: Mazotos, Larnaca. 70 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 83. A resale two-bedroom apartment with title deeds in a well-kept complex in Mazotos, a coastal village south-west of Larnaca. 70 m² of covered area plus a 14 m² covered balcony, an open-plan living room with fitted kitchen, a family bathroom and a guest WC with shower, and air conditioning throughout. Sold fully furnished with an allocated covered parking bay, a storage unit and use of the communal pool. The advert gives 10 minutes to the sea and 20 minutes to Larnaca airport. Asking €130,000, about €1,860/m². Communal fees: about €1,295 a year.

item.title: €125,000 · 19th-century stone village house with wisteria courtyard and terrace in Frayssinet, Lot
item.description: Frayssinet, Lot. 113 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 80. A 19th-century stone house on a quiet lane in a peaceful village in the Lot, in Occitanie. About 113 m² with a generous sitting room, a kitchen diner with modern appliances, three bedrooms, one of them on the ground floor, and two shower rooms. The agent describes it as comfortable and habitable as it stands. Behind stone walls there is a private courtyard shaded by mature wisteria and a raised terrace. Glazing and heating could be upgraded over time, as the advert says. Shops are about 10 minutes away and a larger town with a railway station 20 minutes. Asking €125,000 including fees, about €1,106/m².

item.title: €156,000 · Fully restored granite house with a private garden in Bravães, Ponte da Barca
item.description: Bravães, Ponte da Barca, Viana do Castelo. 74 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 76. A traditional Minho house in Bravães, a few minutes from the centre of Ponte da Barca, restored from top to bottom with a completely new roof. The works kept the exposed granite walls and the stone window seats and added a white fitted kitchen, pine ceilings, new floors and two bathrooms. Two bedrooms plus an extra room that can serve as an office, 74 m² in all, and a walled private garden with lawn. Good sun and quick access to the IC28 towards Viana do Castelo, Braga and Galicia. Built in 1937, energy certificate E. Asking €156,000.

item.title: €170,000 · Sea-view flat with two balconies near the Aregai marina in Cipressa, Liguria
item.description: Cipressa, Imperia, Liguria. 73 m². 1 bedrooms. RealHunt score 77. A second-floor flat of about 73 m2 in a small three-storey building with shared gardens near the port of Aregai, on the western Ligurian coast. The advert places it a short walk from the beaches and the coastal cycle path, and the photos show open sea from the balconies. Hall, bright living room with kitchen, double bedroom, bathroom and a store cupboard, with a balcony off both main rooms. A cellar and an outdoor parking space are included. There is no heating installed, only the pipework for radiators, so budget for that. Condominium fees about 700 euros a year.

item.title: €72,000 · Red wooden three-bedroom house with conservatory and greenhouse in Arbrå, Hälsingland
item.description: Arbrå, Gävleborg. 108 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 84. A classic red wooden house with white corners in a central, child-friendly part of Arbrå, in Hälsingland. 108 m² on one and a half floors with four rooms, three of them bedrooms, a modern fully equipped kitchen, a shower room downstairs and a bathroom with bath upstairs. Surfaces have been renovated over time, two sides of the facade were painted in 2025 and the dishwasher is new in 2026. Glazed conservatory, greenhouse and carport on a 515 m² plot, district heating. Freehold. Asking 795,000 SEK (about €72,000), around €670/m². Running costs 37,524 SEK a year (about €3,400) plus property fee 4,920 SEK.

item.title: €186,300 · Three-bedroom house with a barbecue patio near the rambla in Colonia del Sacramento
item.description: Colonia del Sacramento, Colonia. 113 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 82. Asking US$205,000 (about €186,300) for a single-storey brick house of 113 m² on a 475 m² plot in Colonia del Sacramento, the old Portuguese riverside town facing Buenos Aires. The advert puts it 300 metres from the Rambla Costanera and a short distance from the old town. It has three bedrooms, two full bathrooms, a modern kitchen open to the living and dining room, air conditioning in the living room and main bedroom, a garage and a private patio with a built-in barbecue. The back garden is large and green. It is described as in excellent condition and ready to live in.

item.title: €190,700 · Four-bedroom house on about five acres in Saint Andrews, New Brunswick
item.description: Saint Andrews, New Brunswick. 150 m². 4 bedrooms. RealHunt score 82. Asking C$299,900 (about €190,700) for a white house of about 150 m² on roughly five acres at the edge of Saint Andrews, a well-known coastal resort town in New Brunswick. It has four bedrooms and two full bathrooms, two bedrooms on the main level and two below, a bright living room with wood floors, a kitchen with wood cabinets and large decks. The land is mostly lawn and trees, with a storage shed, and the aerial photos show the bay in the distance. Downtown shops, restaurants and the waterfront are minutes away. Yearly property tax C$3,679.

item.title: €160,200 · Three-bedroom house in a gated complex with a pool in Puerto Vallarta, Jalisco
item.description: Puerto Vallarta, Jalisco. 94 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 82. Asking MX$3,250,000 (about €160,200), and the advert says the price is negotiable, for a two-storey house of about 94 m² in the Rosales complex in Parques Universidad, Puerto Vallarta. It has three bedrooms, one on the ground floor, two full bathrooms, a living and dining room, kitchen, service patio, front garden and parking for one car. Four air conditioning units and window bars are included, and it can be sold furnished. The walled complex has a swimming pool, terrace and gardens, which one bedroom balcony overlooks. The photos show a clean, bright home ready to use. Maintenance fee not stated.

item.title: €125,000 · Renovated village home with sea views below the castle in Rosignano Marittimo, Tuscany
item.description: Rosignano Marittimo, Tuscany. 58 m². 1 bedrooms. RealHunt score 77. A recently renovated home of 58 m² in the medieval centre of Rosignano Marittimo, at the foot of the castle, with its own street door and windows on all four sides. Beamed ceilings, an open living room with a fitted kitchen that is included in the price, a double bedroom with a storage mezzanine and a large shower room. Several windows look across the rooftops to the Tyrrhenian Sea. Heat pump for heating and cooling, new double-glazed windows, residents' parking a short walk away. Ready to move into. Asking €125,000. The advert states there are no condominium fees.

item.title: €77,000 · 1920s villa with geothermal heating and a private garden in central Vansbro, Dalarna
item.description: Vansbro, Dalarna. 122 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 87. A 1920s house in the middle of Vansbro, on the Västerdal river in Dalarna, with a sheltered 1,651 m² plot next to a playground. 122 m² with five rooms, three of them bedrooms, a separate dining room, a bright living room with a stove and a bathroom between the two upstairs bedrooms. Geothermal heating was installed in 2019, the incoming water pipe was renewed in 2023 and the windows are triple glazed. School, shops, pharmacy, swimming pool and the bus and railway station are within walking distance. Freehold. Asking 850,000 SEK (about €77,000), around €630/m².

item.title: €85,000 · Renovated single-storey country house among olive groves near Gytheio
item.description: Near Gytheio, Laconia. 82 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 87. A single-storey house of 82 m2 on an 845 m2 hillside plot with 17 olive trees, a citrus tree and a vine pergola, recently renovated: new floor tiles inside and out, new kitchen cupboards, restored timber roof, shutters and doors, fresh paint. Living room, kitchen with WC, two bedrooms, an extra room for dining or office, and a bathroom with bath. Two covered terraces look over the olive groves. Air conditioning in three rooms, mains water and electricity, septic tank. Sold largely furnished. Only three other houses nearby, so it is very quiet and you will need a car.

item.title: €90,600 · Ground-floor flat with garden, terrace and garage in Szklarska Poręba, Karkonosze
item.description: Szklarska Poręba, Lower Silesia. 71 m². 1 bedrooms. RealHunt score 80. A sunny 71 m² ground-floor flat in a quiet part of Szklarska Poręba, a mountain resort in the Karkonosze, in a building that was thermally modernised a few years ago. Two rooms, kitchen and bathroom, with a garden and terrace, a large wooden balcony off the bedroom, a garage, a cellar and a store room. Heated by a fireplace and electric heating. The advert says it can be lived in as it is or freshened up. Separate ownership with its own land register entry. Asking 399,000 zł (about €90,600). Fee to the owners association: 600 zł a month (about €136).

item.title: €76,700 · Renovated two-bedroom condo with pool and gym near Chiang Mai Night Bazaar
item.description: Chang Khlan, Chiang Mai. 62 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 86. A 62 m² apartment with two bedrooms and two bathrooms on the 2nd floor of Tree Boutique Resort, a 77-unit building completed in 2017 in Chang Khlan, a walk from the Night Bazaar. The advert says it was fully renovated and is sold fully furnished, with a balcony. The building has a pool, gym, garden, parking and 24-hour security. Listed under the foreign freehold quota. Asking US$84,300 (about €76,700), around €1,240/m². The monthly common fee is not clearly stated in the advert, so ask the seller.

item.title: €89,000 · Sea-view one-bedroom flat with pool and no maintenance fee in Sveti Vlas
item.description: Sveti Vlas, Burgas. 64 m². 1 bedrooms. RealHunt score 84. A furnished 64 m² flat (57 m² net) on the 2nd floor of a small three-storey building in Sveti Vlas, about 300 m from the beach. Living room, separate kitchen, one bedroom, bathroom and two balconies, south-facing with a sea view. Owners share an outdoor pool, green areas and a barbecue corner. The building has its Act 16 permit and, unusually for this coast, the advert states there is no maintenance fee. Inverter air conditioning, energy class A. Asking €89,000, about €1,390/m².

item.title: €180,000 · Furnished five-bedroom mountain house with Ubiñas views in Quirós, Asturias
item.description: Ricabo, Quirós, Asturias. 145 m². 5 bedrooms. RealHunt score 84. A house of 145 m2 in the village of Ricabo, inside the Las Ubiñas-La Mesa Natural Park, with a patio terrace looking straight at the peaks. Renovated inside with redone wiring and plumbing and a new water heater, and sold furnished. Ground floor with living room and fireplace, kitchen, a bedroom, bathroom, cellar and workshop, three more bedrooms and a second living room upstairs, plus an attic. A closed garage and a nearby plot with a vegetable garden are included. Radiators are in place but the heating is not yet connected. Pola de Lena is about 20 minutes away.

item.title: €150,000 · Bright three-floor house with terraces facing Lake Omodeo in Soddì, Sardinia
item.description: Soddì, Oristano, Sardinia. 150 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 81. A large, light house in Soddì, a village of about 100 people in central Sardinia, facing Lake Omodeo. About 150 m2 on three floors: hall, kitchen, living room and bathroom at entry level, a main bedroom with a lake-view balcony, two smaller bedrooms and a second bathroom upstairs, and two cellar rooms below, one set up with sofas, a fireplace and a pizza oven. Two terraces, two air conditioning units, and the advert states the roof is in perfect condition with no leaks and the paperwork in order. The rear terrace needs a refresh.

item.title: €84,500 · House built in 2018 on a 1,181 m² plot near the sea in Shima, Mie
item.description: Ago-cho Tategami, Shima, Mie. 106 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 79. A two-storey wooden house finished in January 2018, far newer than most homes at this price. 106 m² with two bedrooms plus a storage room and a living, dining and kitchen space of over 20 tatami, on a 1,181 m² freehold plot in Ago-cho Tategami, in the Ise-Shima area of Mie. The advert lists the sea within 2 km, mountain views, a supermarket within a 10 minute walk and parking for three or more cars. Water comes from a well and there is a septic tank. Asking ¥14,800,000 (about €84,500), roughly €800/m².

item.title: €218,100 · Well-kept three-bedroom colonial with a metal roof in Geneva, Finger Lakes
item.description: Geneva, New York. 128 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 87. Asking US$239,900 (about €218,100) for a move-in ready colonial of about 128 m² in Geneva, a small lakeside city in the Finger Lakes region of upstate New York. It has three bedrooms and two full bathrooms, one with a clawfoot tub, plus an enclosed front porch, a large kitchen with a gas range and a generously sized dining area. The furnace, tankless water heater and central air are new, and the vinyl siding and metal roof keep upkeep low. The back garden is private and has a big shed. The photos show a tidy, furnished home. Yearly property tax US$2,919, no HOA fee.

item.title: €175,000 · Restored 1881 stone mansion with castle views in Volissos, Chios
item.description: Volissos, Chios. 129 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 85. A stone house from 1881 in Volissos, in the north-west of Chios, once the village courthouse and later its school. Fully restored in 1998 and upgraded again in 2015: insulation, double glazing, a new tiled roof, solar hot water, renewed wiring and plumbing. 129 m² on two floors plus an attic bedroom under exposed beams, with two kitchens with marble worktops, two fireplaces and two bathrooms. The upper balcony looks over the village to the Genoese castle. The ground floor can work as a separate studio for guests. Asking €175,000, about €1,360/m².

item.title: €95,000 · Renovated two-bedroom whitewashed cottage in Alcaria Ruiva, near Mértola, Alentejo
item.description: Alcaria Ruiva, Mértola, Beja. 46 m². 2 bedrooms. RealHunt score 77. A single-storey Alentejo cottage with blue trim and a red door on a cobbled street in Alcaria Ruiva. It was renovated in 2025 with a new white fitted kitchen, a new shower room, new wiring and new plumbing, so it is ready to use. About 46 m² with a living and dining room, two bedrooms and one bathroom. The village is quiet but lived in, and travelling sellers bring bread, vegetables and fish to the door. Mértola and Castro Verde are both under 30 minutes away by car for supermarkets and restaurants. Asking €95,000.

item.title: €130,000 · Detached stone house with garden and valley views near Cascia, Umbria
item.description: Colforcella, Cascia, Umbria. 84 m². 1 bedrooms. RealHunt score 78. A detached stone house built in 2006, so it has the look of an old Umbrian cottage without the old-house problems. It stands at the edge of the hamlet of Colforcella, about 3 km from Cascia, on roughly 600 m2 of its own land with open views over the valley and hills. Inside are about 84 m2 on two floors: two living areas with fireplaces, a fitted kitchen, one double bedroom and two bathrooms, with beams and terracotta floors. Gas heating, private parking and a small store. Sold fully furnished by the owner and described as ready to use.

item.title: €149,000 · One-bedroom flat with a sunny terrace, shared pool and sea views in Almuñécar
item.description: Almuñécar, Granada. 45 m². 1 bedrooms. RealHunt score 77. A 45 m² flat in Los Pinos, a hillside residential area of Almuñécar on the Costa Tropical, in a small white complex of only five homes. One bedroom, one bathroom, an open kitchen behind a brick arch and a living room with air conditioning that opens onto a wide tiled terrace. A few steps away are the shared pool and a covered barbecue area, both looking straight out over the Mediterranean and the coast. Terracotta floors, sold empty and clean. The price has been cut by about 10% to €149,000. Community fees are not stated in the advert.

item.title: €170,000 · Four-bedroom village house with a sea-view roof terrace in Othos, Karpathos
item.description: Othos, Karpathos. 165 m². 4 bedrooms. RealHunt score 89. A three-floor house of 165 m² in Othos, the highest village on Karpathos, renovated in 2014. Four bedrooms and four bathrooms, a large separate kitchen with a breakfast bar and a bright tiled living room. The top floor opens onto a wide terrace that looks over the white village, the hills and the Aegean. It is connected to mains water and sewage, and the village centre is a walk away. The advert puts Pigadia, the island capital and ferry port, 12 km away and Sikelao beach 8 km away. Asking €170,000, about €1,030/m², low for an island house this size.

item.title: €54,300 · Misawa-built family house with a partial sea view on Awaji Island, Hyogo
item.description: Fukakusa, Awaji, Hyogo. 91 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 82. Built in October 2000 by Misawa Homes and, according to the agent, carefully used inside. 91 m² with three bedrooms, a living room of over 15 tatami and a wooden deck in the garden, on a 152 m² freehold plot in a holiday-home area of Fukakusa on Awaji Island. The outer walls and roof were redone in 2015. Part of the sea can be seen from the upper floor and Shintoshi bathing beach is about 3.8 km away. Immediate handover. Asking ¥9,500,000 (about €54,300), around €600/m².

item.title: €167,000 · Stone-built three-bedroom house with gulf views in Ano Volos, at the foot of Pelion
item.description: Ano Volos, Magnesia. 114 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 85. A stone-faced house built in 2004 in Agios Georgios, an old quarter of Ano Volos on the road up to Portaria. 114 m² on three levels with three bedrooms, two bathrooms, two kitchens and a living room with a fireplace. A veranda and a small garden face west over Volos and the Pagasetic Gulf. Oil central heating with radiators, new air conditioning units, a solar water heater, a storage room and private parking. Sold partly furnished. The advert puts the Volos waterfront 6.5 km away and Anavros beach 6 km away. Asking €167,000, about €1,465/m².

item.title: €160,000 · Move-in ready villa with modern kitchen, big terrace and open field views near Høng
item.description: Sæby, near Høng. 101 m². 3 bedrooms. RealHunt score 82. A bright, well-kept villa in the village of Sæby, a short drive from Høng in West Zealand, registered as a villa for year-round living and described as ready to move into. 101 m² from 1948 with a modern white handle-free kitchen open to the dining area, a roomy living room, three rooms including a first floor with skylights, and a bathroom with a separate shower. Outside there is a large wooden terrace, an easy green garden on a 491 m² plot, a carport and open views over the fields. Asking 1,195,000 DKK (about €160,000), around €1,585/m². Owner costs 1,291 DKK a month (about €173).

item.title: €125,000 · Furnished one-bedroom ground-floor flat with a private yard in Elounda, Crete
item.description: Elounda, Crete. 35 m². 1 bedrooms. RealHunt score 79. A ground-floor flat of 35.5 m² in Elounda, one of the best-known resort towns in Crete, sold fully furnished and ready to use. An open kitchen and living room with air conditioning opens onto a front balcony, and the double bedroom gives straight onto a private walled yard with a tree and a seating area. Modern shower room, solar panels for hot water and a 20 m² basement storage room. The advert puts Agios Nikolaos under 10 minutes away by car and Heraklion airport about an hour away. Asking €125,000, a low entry price for Elounda.
